title: At the Station, and When Things Go Wrong
label: ch:ur-at-the-station-and-when-things-go-wrong
canDo: I can buy a ticket and ask when the next train leaves (ek ṭikaṭ dījiye, aglī gāṛī kab hai?), and say what went wrong (merā thailā kho gayā, merī gāṛī chhūṭ gaī).

payoff.summary: Complete UR-R271-at-the-station: buy a ticket, ask when, and say what went wrong.
